data.theorem_title: A nonempty generalized harmonic sum is positive
data.formal_statement:
namespace ZipfLaw

theorem genHarmonic_pos (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (s : ℝ) : 0 < genHarmonic N s := by sorry

end ZipfLaw
data.natural_language_statement: For every integer $N\ge1$ and real exponent $s$, the generalized harmonic sum $H_{N,s}=\sum_{k=1}^{N} k^{-s}$ is strictly positive. This ensures that the common normalizing factor can be cancelled and logarithms of supported Zipf probabilities are well-defined.
data.source: Wikipedia, "Zipf's law", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipf%27s_law, section "Formal definition"; auxiliary lemma for the original ZipfLaw mission, derived from its displayed PMF and generalized harmonic sum.
